rationale: pulp_add_plugin LITE_EDITOR builds a plug-in's macOS binaries without the GPU plug-in and window hosts and links lite copies of four canvas/view sources (PULP_LITE_EDITOR selects their CoreText and no-op bodies), so those binaries carry no Skia, Dawn or Tint. Binaries that do not opt in, and every library, are unchanged; the full-stack paths are the defaults of the new switches. Lite editors render byte-identically on the CoreGraphics host they already used. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
